title: Local perfection of the exterior dual determinant pairing
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $M$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Write $M^\vee$ for its internal dual [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and use sheafified exterior powers [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Let $n,r\geq0$ and let $f:\bigwedge^n M^\vee\to(\bigwedge^n M)^\vee$ be a morphism whose value on every pair of wedges of sections over any open $W$ is $\det(\varphi_j(a_i))$. Suppose an open $U$ has a sheaf isomorphism $M|_U\cong\mathcal O_U^{\oplus r}$, the finite free sheaf [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Then for every open $V\subseteq U$, $f(V)$ is bijective on sections.

proof.text: Obtain a section basis a, its internal dual coordinate sections φ, the two increasing-wedge section bases b and d, and the evaluation linear equivalence c from the local frame theorem. Form the target basis by transporting d.dualBasis through c⁻¹. This is independent of f.

For indices s,t, evaluate f(b_s) on d_t using the assumed determinant formula. The frame formulas identify the matrix with a.coord_j(a_i) on the corresponding increasing subsets. exteriorPower.ιMultiDual_apply_ιMulti and exteriorPower.basis_coord identify its determinant with the s-coordinate of the t-th exterior basis vector, hence with δ_ts. This equals d.dualBasis_s(d_t). Equality on the basis d, followed by injectivity of c, gives f(b_s)=c⁻¹(d.dualBasis_s).
Basis extensionality identifies f(V) with b.equiv targetBasis (Equiv.refl I). This linear equivalence is bijective. The statement and all hypotheses of the original theorem are unchanged.

theorem exterior_dual_pairing_app_bijective (X : Scheme.{u}) (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (f : Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf (Scheme.Modules.dual M) n ⟶
      Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf M n))
    (hf : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin n → M.val.obj (op U))
      (φ : Fin n → (Scheme.Modules.dual M).val.obj (op U)),
      (f.val.app (op U) (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection
        (Scheme.Modules.dual M) n U φ)).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U)))
        (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheafSection M n U a) =
      (Matrix.of fun i j ↦
        (show X.presheaf.obj (op U) from
          (φ j).app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (a i))).det)
    (U : X.Opens) (r : ℕ)
    (e : M.over U ≅ SheafOfModules.free (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))
    (V : X.Opens) (g : V ⟶ U) :
    Function.Bijective (f.val.app (op V))
